    def render_share_page(
    preview: SharePreviewSchema,
    *,
    url: str,
    image_url: str | None,
    image_width: int | None = None,
    image_height: int | None = None,
    site_name: str | None = None,
    locale: str | None = None,
    link_text: str = "Open",
) -> str:
    """Write the share page of one item.

    A crawler reads the tags; a human is sent to ``preview.redirect_url``
    by ``<meta http-equiv=refresh>`` and, where refresh is blocked, by the
    visible link.

    Args:
        preview (SharePreviewSchema): What to say about the item.
        url (str): The canonical URL (``og:url``); the router passes
            ``preview.canonical_url`` or the page's own public URL.
        image_url (str | None): The absolute ``og:image``, or ``None`` for
            a page without image (``twitter:card`` becomes ``summary``).
        image_width (int | None): ``og:image:width``, when known.
        image_height (int | None): ``og:image:height``, when known.
        site_name (str | None): ``og:site_name``.
        locale (str | None): ``og:locale`` (``pt_BR``); its language also
            goes into ``<html lang>``.
        link_text (str): Text of the visible link to ``redirect_url``.

    Returns:
        str: The HTML document.

    Example:
        >>> from tempest_fastapi_sdk.share import SharePreviewSchema
        >>> page = render_share_page(
        ...     SharePreviewSchema(
        ...         title="<b>Promo</b>",
        ...         description="Hoje",
        ...         redirect_url="https://app.example.com/p/1",
        ...     ),
        ...     url="https://api.example.com/s/1",
        ...     image_url=None,
        ... )
        >>> "<b>Promo</b>" in page
        False
    """
    redirect = escape(preview.redirect_url, quote=True)
    title = escape(preview.title, quote=True)
    tags: list[str] = [
        _meta("property", "og:type", "website"),
        _meta("property", "og:title", preview.title),
        _meta("property", "og:description", preview.description),
        _meta("property", "og:url", url),
    ]
    if site_name is not None:
        tags.append(_meta("property", "og:site_name", site_name))
    if locale is not None:
        tags.append(_meta("property", "og:locale", locale))
    if image_url is not None:
        tags.append(_meta("property", "og:image", image_url))
        if image_width is not None and image_height is not None:
            tags.append(_meta("property", "og:image:width", str(image_width)))
            tags.append(_meta("property", "og:image:height", str(image_height)))
        tags.append(
            _meta("property", "og:image:alt", preview.image_alt or preview.title)
        )
        tags.append(_meta("name", "twitter:card", "summary_large_image"))
        tags.append(_meta("name", "twitter:image", image_url))
    else:
        tags.append(_meta("name", "twitter:card", "summary"))
    tags.append(_meta("name", "twitter:title", preview.title))
    tags.append(_meta("name", "twitter:description", preview.description))
    tags.append(_meta("name", "description", preview.description))
    lang = escape((locale or "en").replace("-", "_").split("_")[0], quote=True)
    head = "\n    ".join(tags)
    return (
        "<!doctype html>\n"
        f'<html lang="{lang}">\n'
        "  <head>\n"
        '    <meta charset="utf-8">\n'
        '    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">\n'
        f"    <title>{title}</title>\n"
        f'    <link rel="canonical" href="{escape(url, quote=True)}">\n'
        f"    {head}\n"
        f'    <meta http-equiv="refresh" content="{_REDIRECT_DELAY_SECONDS}; '
        f'url={redirect}">\n'
        "  </head>\n"
        "  <body>\n"
        f"    <h1>{title}</h1>\n"
        f"    <p>{escape(preview.description, quote=True)}</p>\n"
        f'    <p><a href="{redirect}">{escape(link_text, quote=True)}</a></p>\n'
        "  </body>\n"
        "</html>\n"
    )

    def render_qr(
    url: str,
    *,
    logo: bytes | Path | None = None,
    logo_fraction: float = DEFAULT_QR_LOGO_FRACTION,
    scale: int = 10,
    border: int = 4,
) -> bytes:
    """Encode ``url`` as a PNG QR code, optionally with a logo in the middle.

    Always error-correction level ``H`` and never Micro QR (``segno``
    picks Micro QR for very short text, and phone readers generally do
    not support it).

    Args:
        url (str): The payload, usually the share page of an item.
        logo (bytes | Path | None): PNG/JPEG/WebP drawn in the middle on
            a white frame; transparency is kept.
        logo_fraction (float): Logo side over QR side, at most
            :data:`MAX_QR_LOGO_FRACTION`.
        scale (int): Pixels per module. Raise it for print instead of
            enlarging the PNG afterwards.
        border (int): Quiet zone in modules; 4 is what ISO/IEC 18004
            asks for.

    Returns:
        bytes: The PNG.

    Raises:
        ImportError: Without the ``[image]`` extra.
        ValueError: On a bad ``logo_fraction``, ``scale`` or ``border``,
            or a logo that does not decode.

    Example:
        >>> png = render_qr("https://app.example.com/s/42")
        >>> png[:4]
        b'\\x89PNG'
    """
    _require_imaging()
    decoded = None if logo is None else decode_logo(logo)
    image = qr_image(
        url, logo=decoded, logo_fraction=logo_fraction, scale=scale, border=border
    )
    output = io.BytesIO()
    image.save(output, format="PNG")
    return output.getvalue()

    def make_share_router(
    resolver: ShareResolver,
    *,
    public_url: str,
    fallback: SharePreviewSchema,
    prefix: str = "/s",
    renderer: ShareCardRenderer | None = None,
    site_name: str | None = None,
    locale: str | None = None,
    link_text: str = "Open",
    cache_control: str = "public, max-age=600",
    tags: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    dependencies: Sequence[Any] | None = None,
    include_in_schema: bool = False,
) -> APIRouter:
    """Build the share page and preview image routes.

    Args:
        resolver (ShareResolver): ``async (item_id) -> SharePreviewSchema
            | None``.
        public_url (str): Absolute ``http(s)`` origin the links are
            served from (``https://api.example.com``), without the
            prefix. ``og:url`` and the generated ``og:image`` are built
            on it.
        fallback (SharePreviewSchema): The preview served when the
            resolver returns ``None``. Its ``card`` and ``version`` are
            ignored; an ``image_url`` is kept (a static brand image).
        prefix (str): Path prefix of the routes; starts with ``/``.
        renderer (ShareCardRenderer | None): Draws ``og.png``. Without
            it the image route is not registered, and only previews with
            an ``image_url`` carry an image.
        site_name (str | None): ``og:site_name``, the same for every item.
        locale (str | None): ``og:locale`` (``pt_BR``).
        link_text (str): Text of the visible link a human clicks when
            ``<meta http-equiv=refresh>`` is blocked.
        cache_control (str): ``Cache-Control`` of every response,
            including the image ``404``, so a crawler that keeps asking
            for an unavailable card does not reach the resolver each time.
        tags (Sequence[str] | None): OpenAPI tags, when
            ``include_in_schema`` is set.
        dependencies (Sequence[Any] | None): Router-level dependencies
            (a rate limit). Crawlers send no credentials, so an auth
            dependency here makes every preview the error page.
        include_in_schema (bool): List the routes in OpenAPI. Off by
            default: they are public meta pages, not API.

    Returns:
        APIRouter: The router, to ``app.include_router``.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When ``public_url`` is not an absolute ``http(s)``
            URL or ``prefix`` does not start with ``/``.
    """
    origin = require_absolute_http_url(public_url.rstrip("/"))
    clean_prefix = prefix.rstrip("/")
    if not clean_prefix.startswith("/"):
        raise ValueError(f"prefix must start with '/', got {prefix!r}")
    router = APIRouter(
        prefix=clean_prefix,
        tags=list(tags) if tags is not None else None,
        dependencies=list(dependencies) if dependencies is not None else None,
        include_in_schema=include_in_schema,
    )

    def page_url(item_id: str) -> str:
        """Public URL of an item's share page.

        Args:
            item_id (str): The item.

        Returns:
            str: Absolute URL, with the id percent-encoded.
        """
        return f"{origin}{clean_prefix}/{quote(item_id, safe='')}"

    def image_version(preview: SharePreviewSchema) -> str:
        """Value of ``?v=`` on the generated image URL.

        Args:
            preview (SharePreviewSchema): The item's preview with a card.

        Returns:
            str: Short hash of the version (or of the card itself when
            the resolver gave no version) and of the renderer.
        """
        source = preview.version
        if source is None and preview.card is not None:
            source = preview.card.model_dump_json()
        material = f"{source}\x00{renderer.fingerprint if renderer else ''}"
        return hashlib.sha256(material.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]

    @router.get(
        "/{item_id}",
        response_class=HTMLResponse,
        summary="Share page",
        description="HTML with the Open Graph tags of one item.",
    )
    async def share_page(item_id: str) -> HTMLResponse:
        """Answer the share page of ``item_id``.

        Args:
            item_id (str): The item.

        Returns:
            HTMLResponse: Always ``200``; the fallback when unavailable.
        """
        preview = await resolver(item_id)
        image_url: str | None
        width: int | None = None
        height: int | None = None
        if preview is None:
            shown = fallback
            url = page_url(item_id)
            image_url = fallback.image_url
        else:
            shown = preview
            url = preview.canonical_url or page_url(item_id)
            image_url = preview.image_url
            if image_url is None and renderer is not None and preview.card is not None:
                image_url = f"{page_url(item_id)}/og.png?v={image_version(preview)}"
                width, height = OG_IMAGE_WIDTH, OG_IMAGE_HEIGHT
        html = render_share_page(
            shown,
            url=url,
            image_url=image_url,
            image_width=width,
            image_height=height,
            site_name=site_name,
            locale=locale,
            link_text=link_text,
        )
        return HTMLResponse(html, headers={"Cache-Control": cache_control})

    router.add_api_route(
        "/{item_id}",
        share_page,
        methods=["HEAD"],
        response_class=HTMLResponse,
        include_in_schema=False,
    )

    if renderer is None:
        return router
    card_renderer: ShareCardRenderer = renderer

    @router.get(
        "/{item_id}/og.png",
        response_class=Response,
        summary="Share preview image",
        description="1200x630 PNG of one item's card; 404 when unavailable.",
        responses={
            200: {"content": {PNG_MEDIA_TYPE: {}}},
            304: {"description": "The cached image is current."},
            404: {"description": "The item has no card."},
        },
    )
    async def share_image(item_id: str, request: Request) -> Response:
        """Answer the preview image of ``item_id``.

        Args:
            item_id (str): The item.
            request (Request): Read for ``If-None-Match``.

        Returns:
            Response: The PNG, ``304`` when the client's copy is current,
            or ``404`` without a card.
        """
        preview = await resolver(item_id)
        if preview is None or preview.card is None:
            return Response(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                headers={"Cache-Control": cache_control},
            )
        etag = card_etag(card_renderer, image_version(preview), item_id)
        headers = {"ETag": etag, "Cache-Control": cache_control}
        if is_not_modified(
            if_none_match=request.headers.get("if-none-match"),
            if_modified_since=None,
            etag=etag,
            last_modified=None,
        ):
            return Response(status_code=status.HTTP_304_NOT_MODIFIED, headers=headers)
        png = await asyncio.to_thread(card_renderer.render, preview.card)
        return Response(png, media_type=PNG_MEDIA_TYPE, headers=headers)

    router.add_api_route(
        "/{item_id}/og.png",
        share_image,
        methods=["HEAD"],
        response_class=Response,
        include_in_schema=False,
    )

    return router
